svg.text: Frame 1500, 54 m above ground · both inputs are RGB images; the output is a 3-DoF pose
green box = tile for this frame
x, y: heatmap peak in the tile
Heatmap = CCVPE's probability of the camera position over the tile · the tile is placed around the true position plus a random offset of up to ±18 m (VIGOR test protocol)
